summary: iQSTEL filed an 8-K disclosing a September 16, 2026 First Amendment to its May 29, 2025 Unit Purchase Agreement with seller Craig Span and Globetopper, LLC. The company had acquired 51% of GlobeTopper membership interests, closing effective July 1, 2025, on a $700,000 base price split between $200,000 staged cash and $500,000 in restricted shares priced at a 20% discount to the prior five-day VWAP. The amendment converts the unissued $500,000 share obligation into a $500,000 cash payment under the amended secured note, extinguishing share-issuance duties. Watch dilution relief versus liquidity strain and note collateral.
